turns.question: Who was our best customer in September 2026, and how much did they spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: no metric or dimension breaks spending down by individual customer, so I cannot name a best customer or what they spent. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (Revenue), customers_distinct (Active customers) and repeat_customers, which can be split only by customer country, signup month, order status and similar dimensions, not by customer.
